$comment: The one statement of who this site is. scripts/lib/network_schema.js builds the published Organization node from this file, scripts/lib/served_head_contract.js writes it over every served page (frozen bytes included) and the /about "Our guides" section, scripts/lib/entity_graph_check.js (validate_org_entity_graph.js, and inside the network-crawler-contract blocker) proves every served page says exactly this, and scripts/authority/entity_backlink_watch.js rechecks sameAs and profiles_pending every week. sameAs lists ONLY third-party profiles that exist and resolve now, each with a VERIFIED THIRD_PARTY_PROFILE record in data/authority/verified_same_as_registry.json; a profile not yet claimed waits in profiles_pending and is promoted by the watch the week it resolves and names this site. Never a URL on this site's own host.
name: The Industry Guides
description: An independent editorial publisher of source-backed guides across six regulated service categories, and the company behind the six guide sites it routes readers to.
founder_note: Not applicable: the publisher speaks as an organisation byline (The Industry Guides Editorial Team), so no Person node is published.

profiles_pending.owner_action: Create the LinkedIn company page "The Industry Guides" at linkedin.com/company/theindustryguides (her login) and set its Website field to https://theindustryguides.com/. The weekly watch promotes it into sameAs the week it resolves and names this site.

profiles_pending.link_back_field: Edit profile > Website: https://theindustryguides.com/ (claim the site under Settings > Claimed accounts)
profiles_pending.owner_action: Optional: create a Pinterest business profile "The Industry Guides" at pinterest.com/theindustryguides with its website set to https://theindustryguides.com/. Promoted automatically once the profile resolves and names this site.
profiles_pending.last_result: handle unclaimed (Pinterest answers 200 with a user-not-found body)

self_reference_retired.why: sameAs on the site's own host tells a knowledge graph nothing it does not already know; the grid authority audit of 30 Oct 2026 replaced it with real third-party profiles only. The records stay in the verified registry as RETIRED.
